picks.editorial_note: MIT's Barzilay and Collins won the inaugural Pritzker Prize for AI in Science, global recognition that validates AI-enabled antibiotic discovery as a model for how machine learning can directly produce new medicines.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's AI-guided 'plug and play' design technique produced a broad-spectrum bird flu vaccine with complete protection in animal trials, a concrete step toward faster pandemic-preparedness tools.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's pledge of up to 5% of its equity (potentially $100 billion) alongside SpaceX's giveaways raises major questions about how AI windfalls are distributed to the public, a financial story with outsized policy implications.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University and Stanford researchers showed AI models can learn general predictive skills purely from self-generated synthetic data, a foundational result that could reduce AI's dependence on scraped real-world data.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It

picks.editorial_note: Germany's new TUM-led DZM site in Munich, backed by up to €20 million in federal funding, builds concrete testbed infrastructure for AI-driven autonomous public transportation.
picks.title: Autonomous Public Transportation: TUM Opens New DZM Location in Munich

picks.editorial_note: Google.org funding will let ANU modernize a widely used fusion simulation code with AI, a direct industry-academia investment in accelerating clean fusion energy research.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics maker Unitree, building toward a joint lab, signals deepening ties between academic AI research and commercial embodied-robotics development in a fast-moving field.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: An NIH-funded, Case Western-led multi-institutional effort will use AI alongside satellite imaging and health data to probe environmental drivers of Alzheimer's and dementia, a significant federal investment in AI-for-health research.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: The DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' with Fermilab building agentic tools to automate scientific ML workflows, shows a national lab system standardizing AI tooling as part of a broader federal science initiative.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A $1 million alumni gift, including from an NVIDIA executive, funded 96 DGX Spark systems for Purdue's compute cluster, a tangible industry-academia investment expanding AI research capacity.
